ONE ID, A CLEARER VIEW

Address coins and supported Vault balances appear in separate sections, so you can see where each balance is held.

THE WORKFLOW

From page to balance
in three small steps.

01

Open or paste

Open a Suiscan account or object page, or enter any Sui address or object ID in the popup.

02

Search the chain

The extension queries the public Sui Mainnet GraphQL endpoint for balances and coin metadata.

03

Read the result

See each coin type with on-chain decimals. Supported Vault balances have their own section.

BUILT FOR CLARITY

Useful detail,
without the clutter.

Coin types with the same symbol stay distinguishable by package ID. If metadata is unavailable, amounts are shown as clearly labeled base units.

Supported Vaults

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Your keys stay yours.

Sui Balance is a read-only viewer. It does not connect to a wallet, request private keys, save your queries, or send data to a publisher-operated server.

Read the privacy policy ↗

01 Reads the current tab URL only when you open the popup, to find a Sui ID on Suiscan.

02 Sends the chosen ID and relevant coin types over HTTPS to the public Sui GraphQL endpoint.

03 Shows the results in the popup without analytics, ads, or tracking code.

Good to know

Public endpoint indexing or rate limits can affect results. The extension does not estimate fiat value or calculate positions in other DeFi protocols.
